suggestion.problemOrOpportunity: The key under which a passing npm test row is reused and bound to a publication excludes docs/, .claude/, .agents/ and root Markdown, while the kernel and console product suites read those paths. A product-document edit changed a kernel verdict at an unchanged identity, and the document gate runs no kernel suite, so a write-back after a gate or a docs-only planning branch can land a red product suite that no gate reruns.
suggestion.scope: Decide one of two bounded repairs and add its guard. Either tag the product-suite cases that read documentation as [document] and give kernel a -docs task, so product verdicts are independent of the excluded trees, or add the documentation paths product suites read to the identity as a declared input list. In both cases add a runner fixture that runs the product package suites under a read logger and fails on a read of an excluded path. Out of scope: the untracked-source gap (WO-173-D018) and the rule that reports do not move the key.
affectedUsers: executors and verifiers whose npm test claim stands on a reused row
the reviewer who binds productGate at final review
planners editing product documents on docs-only branches
suggestion.expectedValue: A reused or bound product-gate row again means the suites ran on the inputs they read. A documentation edit that breaks a product case is caught by the gate the editing pass already runs, instead of by a later unrelated order.
suggestion.uncertainty: How many product cases beyond the kernel AC7 case change verdict with documentation content is unmeasured; the console reads may be verdict-neutral. Moving cases to the document gate lengthens that gate by an unmeasured amount.
risks: Adding documentation paths to the identity would bring back reruns after report writes, the cost WO-173 removed
Re-tagging cases moves them out of the product gate, so a code change that breaks them is then caught only by the document gate
alternatives: Leave the key as it is and have the final review always run with --again
Hash only the specific documents product suites read (for example docs/product/02-domain-model.md) into the identity
duplicationHints: WO-173-D018 and FUP-7629e03c6573f5cb (untracked sources in the same key); FUP-71602ec08bc81e9d
suggestion.urgencyRationale: Reuse at this key is four days old (WO-173) and every order's write-back touches the excluded trees. The repair is cheapest before WO-123 and WO-118 compose more suites on the same rows.
